items.title: H. Res. 1665: Providing for consideration of H.R. 3495 and H.R. 5267 (rule)

Resolution: Community members vote Yes/No/Abstain on H.R. 9340 (119th): "Ratepayer Protection Act" as a middleman-free litmus test, then compare results with official House/Senate representative votes.
Funding: Open-ended campaign; voting/timer window begins once $10,000 is funded (Polytab Base USDC wallet). 100% of contributions are directed to verified local/community 501(c)(3) beneficiaries aligned to campaign impact (claim-first, non-custodial routing).
Beneficiaries: Bounty benefits verified local/community 501(c)(3) entities aligned to campaign impact (selected per governance).
Window/Status: House vote held Sept 16, 2026 (within Nov 16-Dec 31 window); subsequent Senate action possible Status: Passed House (Roll Call 312, Sept 16, 2026, as amended) under suspension of the rules, as amended
Proof/Sources: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2026312
Incentive: Non-monetary civic signal and public contrast with representative roll-call votes; honest-zero until real on-chain votes/funding are recorded.
